name: trace
useFor: Use to show what an agent did or is doing: each TraceLine has a TraceIcon (a filled Phosphor glyph for the tool), a TraceTitle and an optional TraceDescription (a duration or a count). Set status running, pending or error. Put a step with detail in TraceCollapsible with a TraceCollapsibleTrigger around its line and the detail in TraceCollapsibleContent. Wrap a line in a link or button to make it open something.
constraints: A spinner on every running step
Colors other than the muted purple and red
Detail that opens without its hairline
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the inbox list's muted text and the Advanced settings disclosure

examples.content: import { EnvelopeSimpleIcon, LightningIcon, MagnifyingGlassIcon, PaperPlaneTiltIcon, PhoneIcon, VaultIcon, WarningCircleIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react/ssr"; import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle } from "@/components/ui/trace"; export function Preview() { return ( Read 3 new emails in acme@inkboxmail.com 0.8s Searched the Agent2Agent directory 2 results Found @summarize and @translate, both public and accepting delegated tasks. Sending the summary to ray@inkbox.ai Call +1 650 474 9720 with the result ); } export function Failed() { return ( Unlocked the vault 0.2s Webhook delivery to https://example.com/inkbox failed The endpoint answered 503 Service Unavailable. Inkbox logs the failure and keeps processing mail. Retry scheduled in 30s ); } export function Linked() { return ( Opened Inkbox A2A: publish your Agent Card ); }

title: Trace
description: An agent's steps as quiet 14px lines with a glyph, a running step that breathes and steps that open to their detail on a hairline.
